# Subway Seat for herdr

Token overrides on herdr's Catppuccin base: sidebar, agent states, accents. `auto.toml` (herdr 0.9+) pairs Walnut and Enamel and follows the terminal.

[herdr](https://herdr.dev) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/herdr/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.toml`](subway-seat.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/herdr/config.toml` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.toml`](subway-seat-tunnel.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/herdr/config.toml` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.toml`](subway-seat-enamel.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/herdr/config.toml` |
| All three | [`auto.toml`](auto.toml) | add to the end of `~/.config/herdr/config.toml` |

## Turn it on

In ~/.config/herdr/config.toml, then `herdr server reload-config`:

```toml
[theme]
name = "catppuccin"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete the block between `# >>> subway-seat >>>` and `# <<< subway-seat <<<` in `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
